s: puM, (kalkaH pApaM hAryyatayA asti asya । kalka + in .) vizRordaSamAvatAraH । sa tu kaliSeze pApAtmanAM vinASAya sammalagrAme Bavizyati । yaTA, -- “samBalagrAmamuKyasya brAhmaRasya mahAtmanaH । Bavane vizRuyaSasaH kalkiH prAdurBavizyati” ॥ tasya karmma yaTA, -- “aSvamASugamAruhya devadattaM jagatpatiH । asinA'sADudamanamazwESvaryyaguRAnvitaH ॥ vicarannASunA kzORyAM hayenApratimadyutiH । nfpaliNgacCado dasyUn kowiSo nihanizyati” ॥ iti SrIBAgavatam ॥ tasyotpattiryaTA, -- “stutvA prAha puro brahmA devAnAM hfdayepsitam । taM SrutvA puRqarIkAkzo brahmARamidamabravIt ॥ samBale vizRuyaSaso gfhe prAdurBavAmyaham । sumatyAM mAtari viBo DanyAyAM tvannideSataH ॥ caturBirBrAtfBirdeva karizyAmi kalikzayam । Bavanto bAnDavA devAH svAMSenAvatarizyaTa ॥ iyaM mama priyA lakzmIH siMhale saMBavizyati । vfhadraTasya BUpasya kOmudyAM kamalekzaRA । BAryyAyAM mama BAryyEzA padmA nAmnI janizyati ॥ yAta yUyaM BuvaM devAH svAMSAvataraRe ratAH ॥ rAjAnO marudevApI sTApayizyAmyahaM Buvi । punaH kftayugaM kftvA DarmmAn saMsTApya pUrvvavat । kalivyAlaM saMnirasya prayAsye svAlayaM viBo ॥ ityudIritamAkarRya brahmA devagaRErvftaH । jagAma brahmasadanaM devASca tridivaM yayuH ॥ mahImASvAsya BagavAn nijajanmakftodyamaH । samBalagrAmaviprarzimAviveSa parAtmakaH ॥ sumatyAM vizRuyaSasA garBamADatta vEzRavam । grahanakzatrarASyAdisevitaSrIpadAmbujam ॥ sarit samudrA girayo lokAH sasTARujaNgamAH । saharzA fzayo devA jAte vizRO jagatpatO ॥ baBUva sarvvasatvAnAmAnando viviDASrayaH । nftyanti pitaro hfzwAstuzwA devA jaguyaSaH ॥ cakrurvvAdyAdi ganDarvvA nanftuScApsarogaRaH । dvAdaSyAM Suklapakzasya mADave mAsi mADavaH । jAto dadfSatuH puttraM pitarO hfzwamAnasO ॥ DAtrI mAtA mahAzazWI nAqIcCettrI tadAmbikA । gaNgodakakledamokzA sAvitrI mArjjanodyatA ॥ tasya vizRoranantasya tadA tatpitarO dfzwvA vismayApannamAnasO ॥ BramasaMskAravattatra menAte tasya mAyayA । tatastu samBalagrAme sotsavA jIvajAtayaH ॥ maNgalAcArabahulAH pApatApavivarjjitAH । sumatistaM sutaM labDvA vizRuM jizRuM jagatpatim ॥ pUrRakAmA vipramuKyAnAhUyAdAdgavAM Satam । hareH kalyARakfdvizRuyaSAH SudDena cetasA ॥ sAmargyajurvvidBiragryEstannAmakaraRe rataH । tadA rAmaH kfpo vyAso drORirBikzuH m: कल्कि m. N. of the tenth incarnation of Viṣṇu when he is to appear mounted on a white horse and wielding a drawn sword as destroyer of the wicked (this is to take place at the end of the four Yugas or ages), MBh. &c.
a: कल्किः — The tenth and last incarnation of Viṣṇu in his capacity of the destroyer of the wicked and liberator of the world from its enemies; (Jayadeva, while referring to the several avatāras of Viṣṇu, thus refers to the last or Kalki avatāra: --म्लेच्छनिवहनिधने कलयसि करवालम् धूमकेतुमिव किमपि करालम् . केशव धृतकल्किशरीरं जय जगदीश हरे .. Gīt. 1. 10.)
